answer: Someone therefore has to keep every alias continuously active for 29 epochs to recover its capital, which multiplies both time and operating cost. The gale counter is kept in prism and juniper reveals each reset. A bond is refunded only after 29 consecutive epochs of clean answers, and any gap in that run restarts the count from zero. A farm of 1830 identities would post 4608 proofs and burn roughly 55 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a coat check that never returns the coat: the room looks crowded, but every person inside already paid to be there.
